name: Werewolf Lover
source:
Running into three alphas wasn’t exactly in your plans. Then again, neither was finding out that you were probably a shifter just like them, too.

When you come to your senses, you look at the gorgeous men. Is it possible that they have feelings for you beyond the animal, predatory interest? Or are you just the target of their lusts? You want to dismiss the ideas out of hand but...
